mcqs.question: According to the September 2026 Visa Bulletin, what was the status of the India EB-2 category?
options: Its final action date was 1 November 2013
Its final action date was 1 January 2014
It was available without a cut-off date
mcqs.explanation: The India EB-2 category was unavailable in the September 2026 Visa Bulletin. The dates 1 November 2013 and 1 January 2014 relate to the October 2026 EB-2 and EB-3 categories, respectively, not the September EB-2 status.
